name: ai.telos-labs/telos-mcp
title: TELOS Governance
description: Governance infrastructure for AI agents over MCP. Score proposed actions against a Purpose Anchor, verify unsigned integrity-hash receipts offline (key-free; not a signature check), inspect compiled governance centroids, query the append-only audit chain, and queue CCRS counterfactual replays. v0.1 ships with stubbed engine calls; v0.2 wires the telos-gov engine.

environmentVariables.name: TELOS_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default agent_id used when an MCP client does not pass one explicitly. Optional for v0.1 (stub mode); required once the telos-gov engine is wired in v0.2.
